3D MATH (pure functions on [x,y,z] arrays)
- mat3 multiply (3x3 nested arrays), rotX/rotY/rotZ(a) standard right-handed rotation matrices, transformPoint(m,v), cross(a,b), dot(a,b), normalize(v), sub(a,b).

GEOMETRY
- Cube: 8 vertices at ±1 on each axis. 6 quad faces wound COUNTER-CLOCKWISE when viewed from outside, ordered +X, -X, +Y, -Y, +Z, -Z; each quad split into 2 triangles (12 triangles total). - Precompute PER-VERTEX Gouraud attributes for the 8 vertices generically from face adjacency: vertex normal = normalize(sum of outward unit normals of all faces containing that vertex), vertex base color = average of adjacent face base colors. (For this cube the normal equals normalize(vertex).) This makes the Gouraud interpolation genuinely visible across the flat quads.

PIPELINE PER FRAME
1) Rotation from accumulated animation time `animTime` (seconds; only advanced when not paused): rotY = t*0.6, rotX = t*0.37, rotZ = t*0.21; model matrix M = Ry·Rx·Rz (composed via mat3 multiply).
2) MOVING POINT LIGHT in world space (cube centered at origin): angle a = t*0.9; L = (cos(a)*4.2, 1.1 + sin(a*0.63)*1.9, sin(a)*4.2). Warm-white light color (1.0, 0.95, 0.87).
3) Camera at origin looking along +z; view position of world point p = p + (0,0,6) (CAM_DIST = 6). Focal length f = min(w,h)*1.12. Perspective projection: sx = w/2 + x*f/z, sy = h/2 - y*f/z (NOTE the y flip for screen space).
4) PER-VERTEX LAMBERT lighting in world space: rotated normal n = M·vertexNormal (rotation-only matrix so no inverse transpose needed), l = normalize(L - worldPos), diffuse = max(dot(n,l), 0); intensity = clamp(0.16 + 1.25*diffuse * (1/(1 + 0.008*distSq)), 0, 1) where distSq = |L - worldPos|²; vertex color = vertexBaseColor × intensity × lightColor (per channel).

Draw front-facing (unculled) edges at full brightness; back-facing edges dimmed (~35%) so the 3D form still reads.

- After putImageData: project the light position through the same camera; if view z > 0.1 draw a glow — radial gradient circle radius ~22px (white core → transparent) with globalCompositeOperation 'lighter', then restore the composite operation.

- Top-left lines: `FPS  <rounded>` using EMA smoothing (fps += (1000/frameMs - fps)*0.08, init 60); `MODE  GOURAUD SHADED` or `WIREFRAME`; `STATE RUNNING` or `PAUSED`; `TRIS  <drawn>/12 (culled <n>)`.
